description: Predictions for the construct trials RS-73 to RS-84 (spec proofgate-brushup, Step 7, second round), written on 2026-11-22 BEFORE these Patterns existed or were run with ProofGate (main at 32f1c63). Never edit this file.

patterns.basis: reasoning from the template and the rules (written before any run with ProofGate)
patterns.note: A Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream (L1) writes to the protected bucket with its own role. Nobody can pass or change the role.

patterns.basis: reasoning from the template and the rules (written before any run with ProofGate)
patterns.note: A Glue job with a role that has the AWS managed policy service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole and reads the protected bucket. A managed policy outside the three that are read is rejected.

patterns.basis: reasoning from the template and the rules (written before any run with ProofGate)
patterns.note: A CodePipeline with an S3 source (the protected bucket) and a CodeBuild action. The pipeline role trusts the account (an AWS principal written with Fn::Join and Ref AWS::Partition), which cannot be read in a trust policy, so the template is rejected (as RS-52).

patterns.basis: reasoning from the template and the rules (written before any run with ProofGate)
patterns.note: An API Gateway HTTP API with a Lambda authorizer and a Lambda integration.

patterns.basis: reasoning from the template and the rules (written before any run with ProofGate)
patterns.note: A DynamoDB table with a stream that triggers a Lambda function (the function role gets stream permissions).

patterns.basis: reasoning from the template and the rules (written before any run with ProofGate)
patterns.note: An AppSync GraphQL API with a Lambda data source (AppSync service role with an inline policy).

patterns.basis: reasoning from the template and the rules (written before any run with ProofGate)
patterns.note: A Cognito identity pool that allows unauthenticated identities, with an unauthenticated role (trust: the Federated principal cognito-identity.amazonaws.com with Conditions) that reads the protected bucket. Anyone on the internet can get the credentials. ProofGate reads service principals only, so it sees no path (class D, a known miss).

patterns.basis: reasoning from the template and the rules (written before any run with ProofGate)
patterns.note: A deploy role with iam:PassRole and sagemaker:CreateNotebookInstance, and a role that trusts SageMaker and reads the protected bucket.

patterns.note: An AWS Backup plan with a selection: CDK creates a role with AWS managed policies (the Backup service role policies). Rejected as managed policies outside the three.

patterns.note: An AWS Config configuration recorder with a role that has the managed policy service-role/AWS_ConfigRole.

patterns.basis: reasoning from the template and the rules (written before any run with ProofGate)
patterns.note: An EC2 instance whose role has AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore (the usual way to use Session Manager) and reads the protected bucket. Rejected as a managed policy outside the three.

patterns.note: An EventBridge Scheduler schedule (L1) with a role that trusts scheduler.amazonaws.com and may invoke a Lambda function.
